name: Planner tasks remain usable in dark mode
covers: dashboard summary metrics are not duplicated
description: Verifies dashboard summary clarity and planner functionality in the default dark interface.
steps: Open Campus Desk in a fresh browser profile
Check that each dashboard metric appears once
Open My Planner
Add a task named Practice equations and mark it complete
expected: The dark interface is active and the task can be created and completed.

name: Switch theme and retain preference
description: Verifies both themes stay visually consistent, including the scrollbar palette, and the mobile workspace navigation remains usable.
steps: Open Settings on the mobile viewport
Select Light mode and inspect page surfaces, controls and scrollbars
Refresh and confirm light mode remains active
Switch to Dark mode and verify the page surfaces, controls and scrollbars update together
expected: The chosen theme persists, scrollbar tracks and thumbs match the selected forest/cream/lime palette, browser chrome color matches the theme, and all six mobile destinations remain available in a single bottom-navigation row.

name: Save own AI provider settings
description: Verifies an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and model can be configured without a hardcoded API key.
steps: Open Settings
Enter an HTTPS API base URL, model name and a test key
Save settings and reopen Settings
expected: The configured endpoint and model remain available in the browser settings.

name: Assistant uses planner context and handles provider errors
description: Verifies the assistant uses current planner context and gives useful feedback when the configured provider fails.
steps: Configure an API key in Settings
Create a planner task named Review algebra
Open AI Assistant and ask for help prioritizing tasks
If the provider request fails, inspect the assistant reply and use Clear assistant chat
expected: The assistant returns a provider answer or a visible troubleshooting response, and chat can be cleared.

name: Reject invalid marks and keep core tools
covers: mobile navigation fits in one row
description: Verifies quick tools and navigation remain usable at a narrow viewport.
steps: Open Quick Tools at the mobile viewport
Check the bottom navigation has one row with all six destinations
Check that the tools fit without horizontal page scrolling
Enter scored marks greater than total marks and submit
Start and pause the focus timer
expected: The panels fit the narrow viewport, invalid marks are rejected, and the focus timer starts and pauses.
